scenes.text: She opens the junk drawer looking for tape... and finds $40.
scenes.say: [curious] She opens the junk drawer looking for tape... and finds forty dollars.
scenes.head: THE DRAWER WORTH $27 BILLION

scenes.text: A gift card. From two birthdays ago.
scenes.say: [amused] A gift card. From two birthdays ago.

scenes.text: And it's not just her drawer.
scenes.say: [conspiratorial] And it's not just her drawer.

scenes.text: 43% of American adults have at least one unused gift card or store credit.
scenes.say: Forty-three percent of American adults have at least one unused gift card or store credit.
[impressed] The average? Two hundred forty-four dollars each.

scenes.text: Now add up every drawer in the country...
scenes.say: [building up] Now add up every drawer in the country...
[amazed] About twenty-seven billion dollars. Just sitting there.

scenes.text: Gift cards. The only money that hides from you.
scenes.say: [deadpan] Gift cards. The only money that hides from you.

scenes.text: Some expire. Some stores close. Some just get... forgotten.
